benefits.title: Why Customers & Workers Trust FairGig
benefits.desc: By shifting governance from corporate platform middlemen to registered worker cooperatives, we deliver better service quality at democratic, standardized rates.
benefits.b1Desc: No dynamic surge multipliers or predatory commissions. You pay honest hourly and per-meter rates agreed upon by trade federations.
benefits.b2Desc: Technicians are vetted members of registered district cooperatives with documented experience, background checks, and guild endorsements.
benefits.b3Desc: Jobs are protected by collective dispute resolution. If work does not meet agreed specifications, the cooperative federation ensures swift rectification.
benefits.b4Desc: Your payment directly supports trade families and cooperative welfare funds instead of enriching offshore venture capital aggregator platforms.

howItWorks.title: How FairGig Works
howItWorks.desc: A complete 6-step cooperative model designed for complete transparency, guaranteed artisan quality, and dignified fair wages.
howItWorks.s1Desc: Choose certified plumbers, electricians, gardeners, carpenters, or cleaners with standardized guild qualifications.
howItWorks.s2Desc: See transparent hourly rates and fixed transport fees upfront with zero surge markups or hidden platform fees.
howItWorks.s3Desc: Your request is routed directly to the nearest local trade cooperative guild. An insured, vetted artisan is assigned.
howItWorks.s4Desc: Track artisan arrival in real time, view verified cooperative credentials, and coordinate instructions securely.
howItWorks.s5Desc: Service is delivered adhering to state-certified safety protocols and backed by ₹5 Lakh comprehensive insurance protection.
howItWorks.s6Desc: Confirm work satisfaction and pay seamlessly. 100% of the wage goes directly to the worker-owner, ensuring dignified labor.

testimonials.title: Trusted by Customers & Trade Specialists

testimonials.t1Quote: The electrician arrived within 40 minutes, repaired our sub-distribution wiring seamlessly, and the bill was exactly what the standard hourly rate stated. No hidden surge pricing!

testimonials.t3Quote: Joining the worker cooperative changed my family's life. Rather than losing 30% of my hard work to predatory apps, I earn a guaranteed floor wage and have collective health coverage.

faqs.q1: How do I reschedule or cancel a booked service?
faqs.a1: You can manage your bookings directly from your 'My Bookings' dashboard. Active and pending requests can be rescheduled or cancelled with zero penalty prior to worker dispatch.
faqs.q2: Are all trade workers certified and verified?
faqs.a2: Yes. Every specialist on FairGig is verified by an affiliated local cooperative society and vetted for certified trade skills, government ID documentation, and floor wage compliance.
faqs.q3: How does fair pricing work without surge charges?
faqs.a3: Unlike conventional aggregator apps that inflate prices during peak hours, FairGig operates on standardized hourly and per-meter tariff cards determined democratically by trade unions and federations.
faqs.q4: How can a local cooperative society join the platform?
faqs.a4: Registered cooperative societies can submit their registration documents through our 'Affiliate Co-op' portal. Our apex verification team reviews and approves societies within 48 business hours.

welfare.title: Fair Trade Worker Welfare Guarantee
welfare.subtitle: How your booking empowers gig professionals with dignity and safety
welfare.desc: Unlike conventional gig platforms that exploit workers with high commissions and zero safety nets, FairGig is governed by democratic worker cooperatives.
welfare.cover1Desc: Full accidental disability and trauma protection for every worker while on duty.
welfare.cover2Desc: Cashless emergency medical coverage so no tradesperson faces catastrophic health debt.
welfare.cover3Desc: 5% of service rates are pooled into the society welfare fund for emergency distress grants.
welfare.cover4Desc: Workers collectively own their cooperative societies and set fair floor wages.
welfare.peaceOfMind: Your Peace of Mind: When you hire through FairGig, you receive skilled, background-verified professionals protected by India's National Cooperative Workers Insurance Trust.
